name: dualcontrol
title: Dual Control
description: For driving instructors: a road-marking white page in tarmac-grey humanist lettering where every service is a green direction sign on grey posts, with an inset white border, the lesson's name over a white rule, its price in yellow brackets like a route number and a white arrow, and the call button in L-plate red.

tokens.--font-sign: all lettering: headings, body text, signs and buttons (one humanist sans in mixed case, as on road signs)
tokens.--text-s: small text: dates, table headings, who said a quote, the word over the number on the call sign, page numbers, the footer
tokens.--text-m: base body size, and the business name on small screens
tokens.--text-l: names on the signs, the business name on wider screens, the standfirst, customer quotes, the number on the call sign, headings on the white signs
tokens.--text-xl: section headings in page text and the price on a service's own sign
tokens.--leading-tight: line spacing of headings, sign names and buttons
tokens.--color-bg: page background (road-marking white by day, tarmac by night)
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, the business name and menu, the keyboard focus ring and the rule under table headings
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: the standfirst, dates, table headings, who said a quote, page numbers, the footer, and the dashes of a rule in page text
tokens.--color-accent: links in the text and the line under the current menu item
tokens.--color-line: hairlines: under the masthead, between table rows, around code blocks
tokens.--color-sign: the green of the direction signs, the small sign beside the business name and the ticks in the list of what a price covers
tokens.--color-sign-ink: lettering, inset border, rule and arrow on the green signs, and the dashes down the middle of the road
tokens.--color-route: the price in brackets on a sign, the double yellow lines beside a customer quote, and selected text
tokens.--color-plate: ground of the white signs: the call block, the list of what a price covers and the skip link
tokens.--color-plate-ink: lettering, inset border and focus ring on the white signs, and the ink of selected text
tokens.--color-post: the posts the signs stand on
tokens.--color-road: the strip of road under the signs and above the footer, and the kerb behind the double yellow lines
tokens.--color-call: the call button, and the letter on its L-plate
tokens.--color-on-call: lettering on the call button, and the L-plate's own ground
tokens.--measure: widest a column of text may get
tokens.--aside-width: width of the call sign when it stands beside the text on wide screens
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between list items, between lines on a sign
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between stacked signs, above and below the rule on a sign
tokens.--space-3: standard gap: between paragraphs, between the two columns of signs, the page's side margin on small screens
tokens.--space-4: gap between the sections of a page, and the page's side margin on wide screens
tokens.--space-5: space under the page, and between the two halves of the home page
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the signs and the cover picture (buttons, code blocks and pictures in the text take half of it)
tokens.--sign-edge: width of the coloured edge outside a sign's border
tokens.--sign-border: thickness of a sign's inset border, and of the ticks
tokens.--rule: thickness of the rule on a sign, the road's centre line, the line under table headings and a rule in page text
tokens.--arrow: length of the arrow on a sign
tokens.--post-height: how far the posts show below the lowest sign
tokens.--road-height: height of the strip of road
tokens.--focus-width: thickness of the keyboard focus ring and of the line under the current menu item
tokens.--tap: smallest height of anything meant to be tapped: buttons, menu links
